environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (no NAT gateway, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint service backed by an internal NLB. The NLB target group health checks on /health. The VPC endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled and the allowed principal list is restricted to a single consumer account (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root). Consumer VPC endpoint has a VPC endpoint policy that only permits connections from CIDR 10.200.0.0/24 (internal monitoring subnet). No public DNS resolution exists for the service; the endpoint is only resolvable via the vpce-*.region.vpce.amazonaws.com private DNS entry within the consumer VPC.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate, platform version 1.4.0, private subnets only
config.network: VPC 10.100.0.0/16, private subnets 10.100.10.0/24 and 10.100.11.0/24, no IGW, no NAT
config.nlb: internal NLB in same private subnets, listener TCP 8443 -> target group
config.security_group_on_tasks: sg-0def456: inbound TCP 8443 from NLB private IPs only
config.route_tables: no route to 0.0.0.0/0 in any subnet
